Sample.evidence_source: The most notable limitation of the study is the small sample size of four male students from a single University, and because of this, data saturation was not achieved.

Country.evidence_source: Given this restriction, the lived experiences of the participants cannot be ascribed to the broad population of young males in South Africa.

Type.evidence_source: The most notable limitation of the study is the small sample size of four male students from a single University, and because of this, data saturation was not achieved. Given this restriction, the lived experiences of the participants cannot be ascribed to the broad population of young males in South Africa.

Area.evidence_source: However, the study serves as a stepping stone to a more nuanced understanding of how young South African men view suicidal behaviour, its causes and its catalysts.
